title: A loaf of bread, timed
checked: Every reachable state checked (9 states, 12 with their data, 13 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: The dough doubles before it is shaped
rules.says: Nobody shapes a loaf from dough that has not risen.
rules.path: Take away the doubled guard and it breaks in 4 steps: next step, next step, next step, next step.

rules.rule: No slice while it is hot
rules.says: The bread is cut only after an hour on the rack.
rules.path: Take away the cool guard and it breaks in 9 steps: next step, next step, next step, wait, next step, next step, next step, out of the oven, slice it.
